context: Ongoing: Vent path sizing and cell spacing to contain a single-cell runaway. This week: Dmitri books the battery cage for the containment test; heater trigger fixture still on order.
Ongoing: BMS PCBA rev 1 balancing current and cell-tap fusing. This week: BMS boards in; balancing current measures 48 mA instead of 100 mA.
Ongoing: Aluminum links gall on 303 pins under side load. This week: Rev B finger links and pins released with the tactile board change.
Ongoing: Backlash in the rev B cycloidal reducer and whether to shim or re-grind. This week: Life check after 50k reversals: backlash up to 0.22 deg, accepted for DVT with a note.
Ongoing: Running the knee at 40 C ambient for DVT; chamber access and feedthrough. This week: Feedthrough plate arrives; first soak shows grease migration at 40 C after 3 h.
Ongoing: Integrated DVT plan across actuators and legs and which dates are real. This week: Actuator build slips; gate review held anyway with partial data.
Ongoing: Leg drop gantry shared by leg drop, torso static load and ankle impact. This week: Lukas wants a full week for torso static load; Priya needs it for the DVT leg drop.
